## Overview

Document the GB300 Kimi-K3 AgentX lanes of [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4516](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4516) (head `5a397acc`) in `recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml`: the refreshed TP8 + DCP8 xPyD lane (`kimik3-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-mooncake-dcp8-disagg`) and a new 3P1D lane with a DEP16 decode pool (`kimik3-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-mooncake-dep16-disagg`). Both run on image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-e4a5b5537344b103ed10de7764378ef09604ef3d` (vLLM `0.32.1rc1.dev466+ge4a5b5537` in the run logs) with Dynamo `a0de541ea8c861d5ac01d15953ca529bea68637b`.

## Claims

**`gb300_agentx_pd` (AgentX xPyD, default):**

- Image and Dynamo pin moved from `nightly-1b2a6663` / `ffbbaaa6` to the ones above.
- Both roles: `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95` (was 0.92), `TOKENSPEED_MLA_FP16_PARTIALS=0`; `VLLM_CONNECTOR_PREFETCH_DEPTH` and `VLLM_CONNECTOR_PREFETCH_KV_CAP` removed (the lane no longer sets them).
- Prefill: `--max-num-seqs 32` (was 64), `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 8192` with an explicit `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` capture list up to 8192, and `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_LIMIT=1024` / `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_WAITING_LIMIT=1024`.
- Runbook: the regular decode adds `--use-replayssm` (the specialized decode does not use it), the Mooncake store connector drops `compact_group_io` and `max_load_batch_keys`, and the frontend runs `--router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 1` (was 900) with `DYN_DISABLE_OPENAI_STRICT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION=1`. The worker table is unchanged (1P2D c56 is no longer run; c48 and c64 remain).

**`gb300_agentx_pd_dep16` (AgentX 3P1D DEP16, new, opt-in):**

- Prefill: TP8 + EP8 across two trays (no DCP), three workers; decode: one DEP16 worker (`--tensor-parallel-size 1 --data-parallel-size 16`, expert parallelism) across four trays. Both roles use MegaMoE, `--enable-ep-weight-filter`, `--max-num-seqs 32`, BF16 KDA state, FP8 KV and FlashInfer autotune.
- Online MXFP8 target quantization through `--quantization-config` `targets`: the KDA `in_proj_qkvgfab`, MLA `fused_qkv_a_g_proj` and latent-MoE `routed_expert_up_proj`/`routed_expert_down_proj` projections on both roles, plus `o_proj` and the shared experts on decode. The DSpark draft is not quantized: the draft is built from its own config (`get_draft_quant_config`), and the run logs show the online quantization pass only while the target loads.
- Decode: `--max-num-batched-tokens 512`, `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 512`, `--use-replayssm`, `tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv: 8`, `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` graphs (vLLM's default, replacing the DEP strategy's `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`), no prefix caching, and a Mooncake `kv_consumer` connector with `enable_lookup: false` (runbook).
- Runbook: services, environment (incl. the NVSHMEM MNNVL settings), prefill and decode commands, frontend.
- `meta.date_updated` bumped to 2026-10-26.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` passes (vllm-project/recipes @ `5eec681`).
- Built the full JSON API before and after: only the Kimi-K3 family files change (`moonshotai/Kimi-K3.json`, its `hw/gb300/strategies/pd_cluster.json` and `presets/gb300_agentx_pd.json`, the three promoted Kimi-K3 variants' index and GB300 PD files) and `presets/gb300_agentx_pd_dep16.json` is added. The GB300 PD default render changes only in the image and the flags and env vars listed above.
- Every value was taken from the PR-head recipes and checked against the dumped engine config of every worker in run [40239967341](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40239967341) (all 8 disaggregated points): 1P3D c16 and 1P2D c24/c32 run the specialized decode (`--max-num-seqs 12`, capture 64, FP32 state, interleave 1, autotune off), 1P2D c48/c64, 2P3D c240 and 3P4D c240 run the regular decode (`--max-num-seqs 128`, `use_replayssm` on), every prefill runs `--max-num-seqs 32` with capture 8192 and `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95`, and the 3P1D c336 workers match the new preset. The rendered prefill/decode argv of both presets equal the lane's logged launch commands (c32 and c336) apart from the synthetic acceptance settings, `--kv-transfer-config`/`--kv-events-config` (runbook), node addresses, and builder flags that restate the lane's effective values: `--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager` (no HMA auto-disable in the logs), `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384` on the xPyD pools (the logs show `max_num_batched_tokens=16384`), and the xPyD preset's existing autotune, prefix-cache and hybrid-LB undo flags.

## Details

Excluded as InferenceX-only or cluster-specific: concurrency lists, synthetic acceptance (`rejection_sample_method: synthetic`, `synthetic_acceptance_length`), AIPerf and trace-replay settings, `--served-model-name`/local model path, `--dump-config-to`, Slurm and container options, health checks, `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE`, `TILELANG_CLEANUP_TEMP_FILES`, `WITH_NVIDIA_PEERMEM`, `NCCL_NET_PLUGIN`, the lane's `NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST`/UCX device lists and DP RPC port (site values; the runbook keeps placeholders). The aggregated TP16 c1 point of #4516 is an image-only bump and stays covered by the `gb300_low_latency` preset's `tp16` point.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.

</details>

+
+  gb300_agentx_pd_dep16:
+    label: "AgentX 3P1D DEP16"
+    hardware: gb300

+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4516", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4516", key: "kimik3-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-mooncake-dep16-disagg" }

+    # Served by Dynamo with the Rust frontend; tool-call flags off under Dynamo,
+    # and the K4 draft is in args instead of the toggle's generic K8 draft.
+    select:
+      pd_router: dynamo
+      frontend: rust
+      features: { tool_calling: false, spec_decoding: false }
+    # GB300: the InferenceX AgentX 3P1D lane (SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4516),
+    # TP8 + EP8 prefill pools (no DCP) and one DEP16 decode pool with MegaMoE.
+    # The pd_cluster Blackwell block replaces the recipe Blackwell baseline, so
+    # the shared serving flags are restated here; role blocks add the rest.
+    args:
+      - "--attention-backend"
+      - "TOKENSPEED_MLA"

+      - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+      - "0.95"
+      - "--enable-expert-parallel"

+      - "--moe-backend"
+      - "deep_gemm_mega_moe"
+      - "--max-num-seqs"
+      - "32"
+      - "--enable-cumem-allocator"
+      - "--enable-flashinfer-autotune"
+      - "--load-format"
+      - "fastsafetensors"
+      - "--stream-interval"
+      - "10"
+      - "--language-model-only"
+      - "--speculative-config"
+      - '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}'
+    # The lane keeps FlashInfer autotune on for both roles.
+    remove_args: ["--disable-flashinfer-autotune"]
+    env:
+      VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER: "1"
+      VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS: "1"
+      VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM: "0"
+      VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
+      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "1"
+      NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE: "1"
+      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "1"
+      NCCL_P2P_LEVEL: "NVL"

+      NVSHMEM_DISABLE_MNNVL: "0"

+      NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING: "1"
+      VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS: "4"
+      MC_SLICE_SIZE: "1048576"
+      MC_MAX_MR_SIZE: "4294967296"
+      MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY: "1"
+      UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE: "n"
+      UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE: "n"
+      UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED: "1024"
+      UCX_TCP_AF_PRIO: "inet"
+      # The qualified workers left UCX on its default transports; this
+      # replaces the Blackwell PD block's rc,cuda_copy restriction.
+      UCX_TLS: "all"
+      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"
+      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "1800"
+      VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT: "600000"
+    roles:
+      prefill:
+        parallelism: tep
+        nodes: 2
+        # Online MXFP8 for the target's KDA and MLA input projections and the
+        # latent-MoE up/down projections; the routed experts keep their MXFP4.
+        args:
+          - "--quantization-config"
+          - '{"targets":{"*.in_proj_qkvgfab":"mxfp8","*.fused_qkv_a_g_proj":"mxfp8","*.routed_expert_down_proj":"mxfp8","*.routed_expert_up_proj":"mxfp8"}}'
+          - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "16384"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[4,8,12,16,20,24,32,40,48,64,80,96,128,160,256,384,512,640,768,896,1024,1152,1280,1408,1536,1664,1792,1920,2048,2304,2560,2816,3072,3328,3584,3840,4096,4608,5120,5632,6144,6656,7168,7680,8192]}'

+        env:
+          VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT: "0"

+      decode:
+        # One DEP16 pool (TP1 x DP16 with expert parallelism) across four trays.
+        parallelism: dep
+        nodes: 4
+        # Decode also quantizes o_proj and the shared experts online to MXFP8.

+    runbook: |
+      The GB300 AgentX 3P1D lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`kimik3-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-mooncake-dep16-disagg`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4516](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4516)) runs Dynamo + vLLM with three prefill workers and one decode worker at 336 clients (40 GPUs). Each prefill worker is TP8 + EP8 across two 4-GPU GB300 trays, without DCP. The decode worker is DEP16 (`--tensor-parallel-size 1 --data-parallel-size 16` with expert parallelism) across four trays. Both roles use MegaMoE, `--max-num-seqs 32` (per data-parallel rank on decode) and online MXFP8 for selected target projections. KV moves over NIXL, and all workers share an RDMA Mooncake store. Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-e4a5b5537344b103ed10de7764378ef09604ef3d`, Dynamo `a0de541ea8c861d5ac01d15953ca529bea68637b`.
+
+      The preset renders one prefill pool and the decode pool. It turns **Spec decoding** off, because the toggle's generic `RedHatAI/Kimi-K3-speculator.dspark` K8 draft was not qualified, and **Tool calling** off (see the parser note under Workers).
+
+      Documented here only: the three prefill workers, the Mooncake store connector (the builder renders a plain NIXL connector, without the qualified MultiConnector, recompute policy and load options), the Mooncake services, prefill `--kv-events-config`, `NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST`, and the frontend's router mode and session affinity (the builder renders round-robin).
+
+      **Target quantization:** `--quantization-config` quantizes these target layers online to MXFP8: the KDA `in_proj_qkvgfab` and MLA `fused_qkv_a_g_proj` projections and the latent-MoE `routed_expert_up_proj`/`routed_expert_down_proj` projections on both roles, plus `o_proj` and the shared experts (`gate_up_proj`, `down_proj`) on decode. The DSpark draft is not quantized: vLLM builds the named draft from its own unquantized config, and the lane's logs show the online quantization pass only for the target layers.
+
+      ### Services
+
+      Start etcd, NATS and a Mooncake master once, as for the [AgentX xPyD preset](#preset-gb300_agentx_pd): `mooncake_master --enable_http_metadata_server=true --default_kv_lease_ttl=60000 --eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 --eviction_ratio=0.10`. The workers' Mooncake store uses P2P handshake metadata, RDMA over the node's NICs, a 160GB global segment and a 4GB local buffer, with offload disabled.
+
+      ### Environment (every worker)
+
+      ```bash
+      export VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=1 VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=1 VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM=0
+      export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1 NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1 NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL
+      export NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none NVSHMEM_DISABLE_MNNVL=0 NVSHMEM_IB_ENABLE_IBGDA=0 NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING=1
+      export NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST=<the node's RDMA HCAs>
+      export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS
+      export VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS=4 MC_SLICE_SIZE=1048576 MC_MAX_MR_SIZE=4294967296 MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY=1
+      export UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE=n UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE=n UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED=1024 UCX_TCP_AF_PRIO=inet
+      export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120 ETCD_LEASE_TTL=600
+      export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800 VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT=600000
       ```
 
-      Session affinity keeps each conversation on one worker so it reuses that worker's prefix cache; send the conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-Id` request header.
+      Prefill workers also set `VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=0`, `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_LIMIT=1024` and `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_WAITING_LIMIT=1024`.
+
+      ### Workers
+
+      Prefill (three workers; run each on its two trays with the same `--master-addr`, the first tray's address, `--nnodes 2` and `--node-rank 0` or `1`):
+
+      ```bash
+      python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --served-model-name moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+        --disaggregation-mode prefill --request-plane tcp \
+        --nnodes 2 --node-rank <0|1> --master-addr <first-tray-ip> --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
+        --tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel --enable-ep-weight-filter --moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe \
+        --quantization-config '{"targets":{"*.in_proj_qkvgfab":"mxfp8","*.fused_qkv_a_g_proj":"mxfp8","*.routed_expert_down_proj":"mxfp8","*.routed_expert_up_proj":"mxfp8"}}' \
+        --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA \
+        --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"trtllm_ragged_backend":"cute-dsl"}' \
+        --speculative-config '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
+        --enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 \
+        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --max-num-seqs 32 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 8192 \
+        --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[4,8,12,16,20,24,32,40,48,64,80,96,128,160,256,384,512,640,768,896,1024,1152,1280,1408,1536,1664,1792,1920,2048,2304,2560,2816,3072,3328,3584,3840,4096,4608,5120,5632,6144,6656,7168,7680,8192]}' \
+        --enable-cumem-allocator --enable-flashinfer-autotune \
+        --load-format fastsafetensors --stream-interval 10 --language-model-only --trust-remote-code \
+        --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}' \
+        --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
+      ```
+
+      Decode (one DEP16 worker; run on each of its four trays with `--data-parallel-start-rank` 0, 4, 8 and 12 and the same `--data-parallel-address`, the first tray's address):
+
+      ```bash
+      python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --served-model-name moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+        --disaggregation-mode decode --request-plane tcp --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
+        --tensor-parallel-size 1 --data-parallel-size 16 --data-parallel-size-local 4 \
+        --data-parallel-start-rank <0|4|8|12> --data-parallel-address <first-tray-ip> --data-parallel-rpc-port <port> \
+        --data-parallel-hybrid-lb --enable-expert-parallel --enable-ep-weight-filter --moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe \
+        --quantization-config '{"targets":{"*.in_proj_qkvgfab":"mxfp8","*.fused_qkv_a_g_proj":"mxfp8","*.routed_expert_down_proj":"mxfp8","*.routed_expert_up_proj":"mxfp8","*.o_proj":"mxfp8","*.shared_experts.gate_up_proj":"mxfp8","*.shared_experts.down_proj":"mxfp8"}}' \
+        --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA \
+        --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv":8}' \
+        --speculative-config '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
+        --no-enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 \
+        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --max-num-seqs 32 --max-num-batched-tokens 512 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 512 --use-replayssm \
+        --enable-cumem-allocator --enable-flashinfer-autotune \
+        --load-format fastsafetensors --stream-interval 10 --language-model-only --trust-remote-code \
+        --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"enable_lookup":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
+      ```
+
+      For tool calling and reasoning output, add `--reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-tool-call-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-enable-structural-tag` to both roles; `python3 -m dynamo.vllm` rejects the vLLM API-server flags `--enable-auto-tool-choice` and `--tool-call-parser`.
+
+      ### Frontend
+
+      ```bash
+      export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600 DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120
+      export DYN_DISABLE_OPENAI_STRICT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION=1
+      python3 -m dynamo.frontend --router-mode least-loaded --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 1
